statement: There is no finite simple undirected graph G on exactly 17 vertices such that every two distinct vertices have at most one common neighbor and the sum over all vertices u of binom(deg_G(u),2) equals 123.
contribution: A complete proof of the frozen nonexistence assertion. Using the primary source's planar exclusion and necessary reductions plus three exact degree enumerations (including an unpruned pass over all 1,081,575 positive degree multisets bounded by 9), the proof reduces to eight degree multisets. A new local deficiency inequality eliminates six, odd-degree leave parity eliminates the seventh, and an edge-disjoint-triangle incidence bound eliminates the eighth. A dated search on 2026-09-09 found no equivalent later primary result, without asserting priority.
